selection: Most recent available numeric observing night (calibrated directory for MuSCAT); first two camera prefixes in lexical order, or first and midpoint frame for the single QHY600 camera. MuSCAT2 reuses the previous four-band sample. Prefer uncompressed copies to avoid duplicate products. Selection fixed before solving.
index_selection: 5200 LIGHT scales 0-6 for every XY/nside2 tile within one degree of each pointing; 42 files covering six tiles, explicit per-instrument configs. Downloads complete before any recorded solves.
sampling: One repetition per frame. Serial local and online calls; alternate backend order within each instrument. Private nova uploads; ten-second minimum pacing between completed online attempt and next submission in each instrument batch. Caches not controlled; shared host.
